text:
1. From the start position, walk feet straight back (staying on toes) until legs are fully extended
2. Create a neutral pelvic and spine position by rolling the pelvis forward, contracting the gluteals, and pulling the belly button to the spine by contracting the inner abdominal muscles (-42)
3. Hold this position for 20 s, then, without letting the knees or hips touch the ground, roll to one side, with the elbow directly under the shoulder, turning the arm to face forward
4. Maintain the neutral pelvic and spine position and roll to the side of the feet, lift hips, and raise the top arm straight up (-43)
5. Hold for 20 s then return to the front elbow plank position and roll to the opposite side and hold for another 20 s
book: BASICS OF STRENGTH AND CONDITIONING MANUAL
